mintAuthority.summary: BENJI is Franklin Templeton's on-chain share record for the FOBXX money market fund, with issuer-native issuance on Aptos, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, and Stellar. The five EVM deployments are UUPS proxies whose native mintShares paths are gated by each chain's AuthorizationModule through ROLE_FUND_ADMIN or WRITE_ACCESS_TOKEN; the Aptos managed-fungible-asset mint reference, Solana Token-2022 mint authority, and Stellar issuer account are also native issuer paths. There is no verified supply cap. ROLE_TOKEN_OWNER upgrade authority remains concentrated in three shared EOAs, an additional Arbitrum/Polygon EOA, and chain-local admin holders, so the corrected canonical scope remains unbounded and concentrated-admin rather than bridge-contaminated.

controls.label: BENJI Aptos managed-fungible-asset access multisig
controls.evidence: At Aptos ledger version 6,783,994,604 (2026-08-16 23:48:58.616170 UTC), the BENJI token object 0x7b5e9cac3433e9202f28527f707c89e1e47b19de2c33e4db9521a63ad219b739 has ConcurrentSupply and BENJI metadata. The Franklin transfer module's 0xe10898758351ac7d32835ca8f7ef75a31232d210::erc20_wrapper::ManagedFungibleAsset resource holds the mint_ref and burn_ref for this metadata, and its access object is administered by 0x9ecaa634a1f5b1e51aed4c14140d8f303e0e450bdabf7cd64a9f9b567770d0dc, an Aptos native 2-of-6 multisig. The resource reports a maximum uint128 supply rather than an operational cap. The exact module call or role path authorizing the transfer module's mint_ref remains an evidence gap; the live mint reference and native admin are nevertheless sufficient to classify this as the issuer's native mint path, not a bridge representation.

The native BENJI mintShares path is onlyAdminOrWriteAccess, so this fund-admin verifier can mint shares directly on subscription settlement. Current MultiSig reads return 11 signers, normal threshold 2, high threshold 6, and two submitters. No operational supply cap was verified.

controls.evidence: Horizon account read at ledger 63,965,579 (last modified 2026-08-15 14:16:13 UTC) shows the native BENJI issuing account with medium threshold 2, high threshold 6, disabled master key, and 14 additional signers. review.evidence: Full control graph re-derived from Franklin Templeton's current network publication and live primary reads on 2026-08-16: Aptos ledger 6,783,994,604; Ethereum block 25,771,006; Arbitrum 495,300,467; Avalanche 92,983,909; Base 50,067,317; Polygon 92,145,977; Solana slot 439,740,044; Stellar ledger 63,965,579. All eight tracked deployments are issuer-native BENJI share records, not holder-facing bridge representations. The five EVM deployments are UUPS proxies with native ROLE_FUND_ADMIN/WRITE_ACCESS_TOKEN mint paths and ROLE_TOKEN_OWNER upgrade paths; the EVM fund-admin reads now report 11 signers with normal threshold 2, high threshold 6, and two submitters. Aptos has a live Franklin ManagedFungibleAsset mint_ref administered by a native 2-of-6 multisig, although the exact mint_ref authorization call remains unresolved. Stellar has 14 additional signers with medium threshold 2 and a disabled master key; Solana Token-2022 reports mintAuthority equal to the mint address with no supply cap. The Solana MultiChain executable module remains watchlisted because its public state did not prove a conserved bridge route. Native issuer minting remains uncapped and upgradeable, periodic whole-supply reconciliation is supported by the transfer agent's official record and recurring SEC fund reporting, and SEC-registered FOBXX supervision remains prudential.
